messages:
Maya (PM): quick mid-quarter okr check — runtime milestones snapshot. shipped: autoscale + canary rollout in hosted. slipped: Dedicated GPU perf target (blocked on infra). need owners for perf PRs and a short comms plan for affected customers.
Ryan (Eng): confirmed shipped autoscale/canary. Dedicated slipped ~2 weeks — hit a driver/kernel regression during stress tests. i can own rollback & hotfix plan.
Priya (Eng): i can pick up the perf PR reviews. which PRs to prioritize? linking #7423 (perf + batching) and #7499 (kv cache opt). @Ryan can you dump the perf traces?
Ryan (Eng): prioritise #7423 first. perf traces attached in the PR — look at the latency spike at p95 around step 4. also note regression only on longer seq lengths.
Hao (SRE): traced the regression to a CUDA/CUDNN mismatch on a subset of dedicated nodes (12.1 vs 12.2). SRE will patch images and roll node pool. ETA ~48h for full remediation.
Leah (Product): product note — 2 pilot customers reported 10–20% p95 latency increase, they care about predictability. recommend a one-paragraph status note and ETA to customer success. I'll draft if we confirm ETA.
Maya (PM): thanks. action items: 1) Ryan: rollback/hotfix plan (owner). 2) Priya: review #7423 first (owner). 3) Hao: node patch orchestration (owner). 4) Leah: draft customer note once ETA confirmed. please update owners in the milestone board.
Ryan (Eng): rolling back the problematic kernel on a canary pool now, will run synthetic load. command i'm using: `kubectl -n infra set image deployment/redwood-runtime runtime=image:redwood-runtime:staging-kernel-fix && kubectl rollout status deployment/redwood-runtime -n infra`
deploy-bot: deploy started by Ryan (Eng) — canary pool: us-west-2a. status: rolling.
Priya (Eng): tagging a couple quick CR reviewers: @Maya (PM) for acceptance criteria, @Ryan for integration notes. leaving short comments on #7423 with suggested microbenchmarks.
Hao (SRE): node patch plan: patch canary nodes -> validate telemetry -> stagger to rest of dedicated pool with 1h gap between zones. will post runbook link once created.
Maya (PM): rough timeline: rollback validation today -> hotfix tomorrow if canary looks good -> full rollout over next 48h. please update `milestones/okr-qtr` board with new dates.
Leah (Product): i'll put a short blurb for CS and add affected customer list. Priya, can you include a simple repro snippet in the PR so CS has context?
Priya (Eng): yep — added `curl` snippet + minimal load command in PR description.
Ryan (Eng): quick ask — code review pings: if reviewers can land #7423 by EOD tomorrow we can avoid a longer dedicated delay.
Maya (PM): agreed. owners, please mark when blocked/unblocked in thread. i'll follow up on the milestone board after deploy-bot finishes canary. :thumbsup:
Hao (SRE): canary telemetry looks normal so far (first 15m). continuing validation.
deploy-bot: canary rollout complete (us-west-2a). all pods ready.
Ryan (Eng): preliminary numbers look better on canary (p95 back within 5%). moving to staggered rollout.
Leah (Product): note captured. i'll ping CS once we hit full rollout and confirm ETA.
Maya (PM): great. final checklist for this thread: mark owners on milestone board, update PRs (#7423, #7499) with CI results, Hao to post runbook link, Leah to send customer note after full rollout. thanks everyone.
